# Proposal: Explain stopped automation

## Candidate and consequence

Preserve a compact, durable explanation when an automated engineering run
stops so a fresh operator can identify the unresolved decision, missing
authority, or external condition without replaying the run transcript.

## Boundary and placement

The candidate changes the campaign-supervision boundary that classifies a stop
and retains continuation state. Placement is probable rather than confirmed:
the explanation may prove reusable outside supervised engineering campaigns.

## Relationships

No relationship to another proposal is currently established. The originating
idea is referenced from the manifest and remains speculative source material,
not proposal authority.

## Uncertainty and evidence needs

Repository evidence is still needed to determine whether terminal receipts
already carry a sufficiently specific cause and decision owner, and whether a
fresh operator can retrieve it without reconstructing event history. Placement
must reopen if a product-neutral consumer is demonstrated.

## Authority

This candidate is formed but not evaluated or accepted. It does not change
roadmap priority or authorize implementation; the decision owner remains the
user or an explicitly authorized product owner.
